name: Kujou Sara
description: Kujou Sara is a tengu and the adopted daughter of the Kujou Clan, serving as a general of the Inazuma Shogunate's army under the Tenryou Commission. Loyal and severe, she carries out the Shogunate's orders without hesitation or question.
